Score utility u = c * (2/pi) atan((x - x0)/(dynamicScoreCenterScale * sqrt(area))) with c = static (0) + dynamic (0.40) factors, x0 = root expected score x (1 - dynamicScoreCenterZeroWeight 0.25) clamped within 0.5 sqrt(area); tables built at MAX_BOARD_LEN and rescaled; at 9x9 the denominator is 4.5 points; gatekeeper uses dynamicScoreUtilityFactor 0.25

Global pooling survives only in the policy head (KataGPool) and value head (KataValueHeadGPool) with hard constants b_avg 14, sigma^2/100 = 0.1; at strict 9x9 (mask_sum_hw 81) the value-head pooled channels are exactly collinear (pool2 = -0.5 pool1, pool3 = 0.15 pool1) and policy pool2 = -0.5 pool1: harmless but 2/3 of those head columns are redundant; today masked by bSizes 7,8,9 + allowRectangleProb 0.5; re-centering the constants would break C++ backend compatibility (not evaluated)
notes: Decision recorded in DESIGN.md: keep constants (compatibility), accept redundancy; mixed 7-9 training is NOT used because the mission is 9x9-only (assumption a05).
